listing.name: Vyruz: Destruction of the Untel Empire (OpenVyruz)
listing.summary: A native engine for Vyruz using the original game data from your own copy.
listing.original_game_title: Vyruz: Destruction of the Untel Empire

presentation.manual_preparation: Use your own vz-data.rsc outside the engine directory; Intro.avi beside it supplies the optional original intro. The normal in-process folder picker selects that game folder and remembers it in game-folder.txt under AppData/OpenVyruz. Do not select a data folder inside the managed engine: the upstream player writes vzconf.txt, session/ and vz.sco into the selected original-game folder and can share or overwrite settings, saves and scores with the original. Preserve that complete writable folder and compatible old runtime before the first start or any change; source format compatibility is not an observed save roundtrip. Normal remembered paths and co-op data use the external user directory. If APPDATA is unavailable, the selected Windows source falls back to an OpenVyruz directory relative to the creating working directory; Core conservatively preserves this declared local directory, including unknown files. External profiles, originals, custom paths and any configured data roots remain outside Core backup/rollback/removal. Core replaces only the official Windows x64 engine. Existing registrations retain upstream replacement ownership. Vulkan/graphics, intro decoding, co-op/network, actual gameplay and real-save behavior remain unqualified; no original import, archive conversion or upstream helper is performed.
